Bill.BriefDescription: Providing for vulnerable adult fatality review.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to vulnerable adult fatality review; and adding anew section to chapter 74.34 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 74.34 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department may conduct a vulnerable adult fatality reviewin the event of a death of a vulnerable adult when the department hasreason to believe that the death of the vulnerable adult may be relatedto the abuse, abandonment, exploitation, or neglect of the vulnerableadult, or may be related to the vulnerable adult's selfneglect, andthe vulnerable adult was: (a) Receiving home and communitybased services in his or her ownhome, described under chapters 74.39 and 74.39A RCW within sixty dayspreceding his or her death; or (b) Living in his or her own home and was the subject of a referralunder chapter 74.34 RCW received by the department within twelve monthspreceding his or her death. (2) All files, reports, records, communications, and working papers p. 1 SB 6491used or developed for purposes of a fatality review are confidentialand not subject to disclosure pursuant to RCW 74.34.095. (3) The department may adopt rules to implement this section.
